stage1.impression: A clean, quiet studio catalogue shot: the blue acrylic carcass and resin horn read at a glance and the soft sweep leaves room for type, but it still reads as a render. The woofer cover is a flat matte plastic disc, the lining looks like grey foam blocks, the compression driver is a crushed black blob, and a bright stripe of light across the left floor plus a weak, colourless shadow keep the speaker from sitting in a real room.

blocking_9: Woofer cover reads as real woven cloth with texture and a soft edge, not a flat matte disc (out of scope here: being reworked)
Lining reads as voile-sleeved polyester batts, not smooth grey blocks (out of scope here)
The floor has no hot stripe: the left floor at [0,810,95,940] is no brighter than the floor around it
The tinted acrylic throws visible blue transmitted light into its own shadow on the sweep
The compression driver shows its form (a rim or body highlight) instead of a 59 % crushed silhouette
The camera-side panel reads as translucent ice blue, not navy (median above 80)
No clipped CG line on the front-right vertical edge

defects.what: Bright diagonal stripe on the floor left of the cabinet (median 232 vs 180 for the floor around it); reads as a light leak
Darker band at the floor-to-curve transition above the stripe, making the sweep's gradient run the wrong way
Compression driver is a crushed black blob (59 % of pixels crushed), no shape or material
Woofer cover reads as a flat, smooth, matte plastic disc with no weave
Lining batts read as smooth grey CG blocks
Camera-side panel is heavy navy (median 62), losing the translucency of the colour
Hard clipped white line on the front-right vertical edge that starts and stops mid-height; reads as a CG highlight
Cast shadow is neutral grey; no blue light from the tinted acrylic on the floor
Grain mottling visible in the sweep at full size; overall flat tonality (white_in 236, few true highlights)

changes.problem: A hot stripe of light lies across the floor left of the cabinet and pulls the eye away from the product.

evidence.measured: lum_median 232 vs 179 above it at [0,600,95,780] and 180 in the foreground at [0,1000,540,1080]; flat across x (232-234)

change.to: power 150 W, position [-0.35, 0.75, 0.5] (lift it off the floor so it washes the curve, not rakes the floor)

changes.expected: The left floor blends into the surrounding sweep, a smooth gradient from foreground to curve with no band.

changes.problem: The camera-side panel goes navy, so the colour reads as opaque cobalt rather than translucent ice.
changes.expected: The side panel lifts to a mid blue where the lining shows through, keeping a clear step darker than the front.

changes.problem: The compression driver is a crushed black silhouette with no form, the darkest and most CG-looking element in the frame.

change.to: specular 0.4 (a soft highlight along the driver's body and rim)

changes.expected: The driver keeps its black but shows a soft highlight that describes its round body and rear cap.

changes.problem: A clipped hairline highlight on the front-right edge stops abruptly mid-height and reads as a render artefact.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 240.5, clip_pct 0.19, rest of the edge median 45

change.to: power 0.45 W, size [0.02, 1.2] (softer, dimmer, runs the edge evenly)

changes.expected: An even, unclipped edge line along the full corner instead of a hot fragment.

changes.problem: The shadow is neutral grey: tinted acrylic should throw some of its colour onto the paper, which is what ties a coloured translucent object to the ground.

evidence.measured: r 127, g 147, b 160: same hue balance as the open floor (r 163, g 183, b 196), only darker

change.from: no refractive caustics (shadow from transmission blocked)
change.to: enable refractive caustics on the key and the sweep as receiver (filter glossy 1.0), or make the cabinet shell's shadow transmit its colour

changes.expected: A faint ice-blue tint inside the cabinet's shadow on the sweep, stronger near the base.

changes.problem: Grain shows as mottling on the clean sweep at full size and the tonality is flat, with no true highlight.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 229, white_in 236; mottling visible in 2x crops of the floor

changes.expected: A smoother sweep and slightly crisper separation of product from paper.

out_of_scope.request: Give the woofer cover a visible woven cloth texture and a soft, slightly domed edge
out_of_scope.why: The cover's cloth shader is being reworked elsewhere; at present it reads as a flat matte plastic disc, the single biggest CG tell in the frame.

out_of_scope.request: Make the lining read as fibrous batts in voile sleeves
out_of_scope.why: Lining shader is being reworked elsewhere; it now reads as smooth grey blocks.

out_of_scope.request: The Ice colour reads as saturated cobalt rather than a pale ice blue in thick sections
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's colour is fixed; flag it for the owner if Ice should read paler.
